rust_summary: a hanging entity breaking, with its dimension (`native_hanging_break_v2`).
doc_summary: `native_hanging_break_v2(player, dimension, kind, pos, cancel)` is asked when a hanging entity (painting, item frame...) of `kind` at `pos` in `dimension` is about to break; set `cancel` to keep it. `native_hanging_break` (v1) is still asked, unchanged. Bundles need "hooks": @API:hanging_break_v2@.
